title: Commercial feedback capture → roadmap decision tree
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Sales, CS, and support currently submit feature asks via email/Confluence; signals are inconsistent and high-touch accounts (Top 50) aren't consistently surfaced into planning. We waste cycles chasing clarifying info and over-index on vocal customers. Goal: Build a standardized commercial-feedback capture pipeline that enriches signals (renewal stage, ARR, usage, support severity, exec advocacy) and evaluates requests through a transparent decision tree that maps to roadmap buckets: Commit, Fastpass (timeboxed), Watchlist, or Defer.
Scope: - Intake form and Slack <> CRM webhook that captures minimum metadata for every ask. - Enrichment jobs to attach ARR, renewal_date, usage_metrics, NPS, last_support_severity. - Decision tree rules with parameterized thresholds for commit eligibility (e.g., ARR > $500k AND renewal < 90 days AND feature impact >= 8) and fallback paths. - UI in Console to surface ranked requests for PM review and approve/export for engineering backlog. - Audit log for SLA and executive review.
Key constraints: privacy (do not store PII), fairness (prevent repeat wins from single account without cross-signal validation), engineering effort must be < 3 sprints for MVP.
Success metrics: - Time from intake to decision <= 5 business days for top accounts. - Reduction in clarification requests by 60%. - % of committed features validated by cohort impact > 70% after launch.
acceptance_criteria: Intake endpoint accepts structured payloads and returns 200 within 300ms
Enrichment pipeline attaches ARR, renewal_date, recent_daily_active_users for account on ingest
Decision tree evaluates rule set and returns classification (Commit | Fastpass | Watchlist | Defer) with explanation
Console view lists top-account requests, sort by score, with filters for renewal window and ARR
Audit trail created for every decision with PM reviewer and timestamp
Documentation (Confluence) and a short training deck for GTM submitted

2026-02-18 — Prototype intake form v0 shared in #pm-requests. Feedback: Sales wants renewal_date prefilled from CRM; CS wants last_support_issue severity attached.
2026-02-25 — Data team (ENG-1842) agreed to build enrichment API; estimated 2 sprints. Linked PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Commercial+Intake+PRD

2026-03-02 — Decision tree draft reviewed. Decision: use weighted signal scoring instead of hard boolean gates for non-top-10 accounts. Top-10 accounts still eligible for override by VP (must log rationale).
2026-03-08 — Design review with Product Design (Jess Kim). UX: inline rationale and link-to-evidence required when PM marks Commit. Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz/Commercial-Intake

2026-03-12 — MVP scope locked: intake + enrichment + decision engine + Console surface. Next: engineering kickoff and security review prep. Created RFC for privacy review: https://drive.google.com/…/commercial-intake-privacy-rfc
